definitions: To spread something out, especially in an organized way.
To design or plan something in detail.
To present or explain something clearly and systematically.
To spend money, especially a large amount.
examples: She was laying out the clothes for tomorrow.
They are laying out the new garden design.
He is laying out his arguments for the proposal.
The boxer was laying out his opponent.
They were laying out a lot of money on the renovation.
